response.justification: Bogdan has genuine distributed/high-throughput systems experience (Sociomantic microservices handling millions of requests/sec) and is currently embedded in an AI-native engineering environment building MCP/agentic tooling, which matches the role's core mindset. However, the resume shows no Python experience at all despite it being a must-have, and his career is a long string of short, overlapping engagements across many unrelated stacks (PHP, Swift, DLang, C#, Java) with little explicit evidence of stakeholder management, agile ceremonies, or on-call/incident ownership.
strengths: Direct hands-on experience with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems (Sociomantic, millions of HTTP requests/sec)
Currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code-generation tooling, directly aligned with the role's agentic-engineering mindset
Broad systems-thinking breadth across web, mobile, desktop, and embedded, plus founder experience running an open-source platform end-to-end
concerns: No Python listed or referenced anywhere in skills or work history, despite it being a stated must-have
Extremely fragmented career history with many short, sometimes overlapping roles, raising questions about depth and commitment at scale
Little to no explicit evidence of cross-functional stakeholder management, agile/scrum ceremony participation, or on-call/operational ownership

key_factors.factor: AI-native/agentic engineering exposure at current role
